Title: Human Liver Cytosolic Stability
Description: Estimates susceptibility to metabolism by enzymes in the liver cytosol, a route often overlooked because routine screening uses microsomal fractions instead. Shah and co-workers screened 1,450 compounds in human and mouse cytosol, measured in vitro half-lives, and combined matched molecular pair analysis with QSAR modelling to derive transformation rules; selected rules were then tested prospectively on a diverse library. Their datasets were released publicly, and the work is described as the first systematic in silico treatment of this liability.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound is unstable in human liver cytosol, with instability set at a half-life under 30 minutes.
